video_title: LeBron & Jaylen Brown Have Philly LOADED... But It All Rides on Embiid

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers' potential as a fully loaded championship contender
quotes.excerpt: A team that's fully loaded is the 76ers. LeBron James there, Jaylen Brown goes there.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: A team that's fully loaded is the 76ers. LeBron James there, Jaylen Brown goes there. They played the Celtics the other night. LeBron living in New York, getting a helicopter back and forth. Shout out to Fanatics. I don't know how that works, but he has a deal with Fanatics and that's part of the offering. So it's all transparent and it's all in the up and up, but obviously we know he's a big 76ers fan.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: No, it's he has a deal with Fanatics and that's part of the offering. So it's all transparent and it's all in the up and up, but obviously we know he's a big 76ers fan.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's health and conditioning are key to 76ers' success
quotes.excerpt: I think the whole thing rides on Embiid. He's coming back at 250, which he was his rookie year.
quotes.quote: I'm buying the 76ers. Obviously Joel Embiid hasn't looked very strong in the preseason, but that's what the preseason is for, to shake out the kinks. But I just love this team. I think the whole thing rides on Embiid. He's coming back at 250, which he was his rookie year, but this is a grown man 250, strong, slimmed down. Obviously it's going to take a while to sharpen his tools back, but LeBron, I think, will be the one that orchestrates everything. There's talks in the off-season about him running a lot of point forward, but I think he's the perfect distributor. If you look at him like you put him in the same position as you put Draymond Green, he's going to be incredible with a ton of different weapons. Edge come is looking to have a big year. Jaylen Brown is a monster. Tyrese Maxey, I saw him in New York just the other day and he's bigger than I realized and he's one of the best point guards in the game. So they got some depth coming off the bench. Nick Nurse, my guy Rico Hines over there, I'm really looking forward to what this team is able to do. I for sure think they're a top two, maybe three, could be the number one team in the East. So we'll see, but I think all of this shit rides on Embiid's health and availability.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's mindset after being traded to the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is a very smart guy and smarter enough to know just go out there and kill.
quotes.quote: I think Jaylen Brown is a very smart guy and smarter enough to know just go out there and kill. Pretty much, go out there and play. Just go out there and let your play do it and he's always done that. His play is always showed up. You never want your words to start meaning or carrying more weight than your play, but Jaylen Brown is someone who has gone out of the court and done what he's supposed to do. So whether he feels he's someone that can he can still lead this team. Even though it's Embiid's team, Jaylen Brown can still be the best player on the team. So again, I know he's going to be playing with the chip on his shoulder and a different type of energy this year and if he wants it to be his team, he can go out there and do that with his play on both sides of the ball because he's one of the best two-way guys in the game.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's mental state following his contract extension
quotes.excerpt: I think it's we're going to see what his mental's like. You still got 200 million.
quotes.quote: I think it's we're going to see what his mental's like. You know what I mean? When you first hear, regardless of what he think he should have got, he didn't show up in the playoffs last year, and I don't think that was a secret and I think that was a leading reason why they didn't give him what he thought he was going to make. But what's his mental like? You still got 200 million. He's still a very talented player. What is he going to come out and pout this year, or is he going to come out and like show these motherfuckers that, hey, I should be making more money? But the only way we're really going to see that is come playoff time, because he was dominant last year. His points were cut in half. He wasn't as effective on the glass, wasn't the rim protector that they thought he would be. He just looked very uncomfortable. And I think, obviously, for some of his caliber, that was Detroit's excuse not to have to pay him what he possibly deserves. So I just think it's really going to be up to him. I hope he comes out with the fuck the world mentality and makes the league pay this year.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's veteran leadership impact on the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Fred VanVleet, his veteran leadership, his wittiness, his ability to hit big shots, his ability to lead.
quotes.quote: Houston, I've been saying since last year, I want to see what they did with a real point guard. I think Amen Thompson did a great job to trying to be a point forward, that's not his position, but I think that helped him grow as a player. But Fred VanVleet, his veteran leadership, his wittiness, his ability to hit big shots, his ability to lead from the point position puts Kevin Durant and Sengun back in their position where they don't have to bring the ball up and initiate the offense. He's going to be able to get them the ball. So I'm really high on what Fred can bring to Houston. You got Marcus Smart backing him up and now Reed Sheppard probably won't have those point guard responsibilities anymore. I'm excited to see this Houston team, particularly allowing KD to slide back in his natural position and catch the ball where he's most effective. Sengun doesn't have to try to be a center point. He's not a Jokic and I think sometimes he almost had to be that because they didn't really have a point guard. So Houston's someone I really like.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami's potential with Giannis and improved spacing
quotes.excerpt: I want to see what Miami does with Giannis, because he's unstoppable downhill.
quotes.quote: I want to see what Miami does with Giannis, because he's unstoppable downhill. Bam's ability to continue to get better and stretch the floor to give Giannis some more space. They surrounded those guys with shooters with Tim Hardaway and Clay Thompson. So interesting to see what what Miami does. I'm excited for the actual season to get started because I think there's a ton of storylines this year and a lot of great young players and teams looking to get at the Knicks. So I think it's going to be a very fun season.
